# =========================================================
# WHAT IS MONKEYMIND?
# =========================================================

MonkeyMind (https://monkeymind.app) is a free, premium digital sanctuary
for meditation, mindfulness, and heartfulness. It was built to help users
quiet the "monkey mind" — the Buddhist concept of a restless, distracted
mental state — and cultivate calm, focused awareness.

The site is intentionally designed as a mindful journey, not just a
toolkit. The user must first complete a "Follow the Light" patience-building
moment before the core mindfulness tools are revealed (it can be skipped).

# =========================================================
# THE MONKEYMIND JOURNEY (USER FLOW)
# =========================================================

## Step 1: Follow the Light (The Patience Game)
URL: https://monkeymind.app/
Description: First-time visitors see a dark screen with a single moving spark
of light. Each tap reveals a short calming moment. The moments move gently
from accepting a restless mind, to settling the body, quieting thoughts and
resting, and end with words of quiet strength. Visitors can skip at any time.
This game is intentional: it builds patience, trains attention, and transitions
the user from a distracted state to a present, meditative one.

## Step 2: The Sanctuary Dashboard
URL: https://monkeymind.app/#sanctuary
Description: After the sanctuary, a bento-grid dashboard shows seven calming
tools: Sanctuary, Breathing, Let It Go, Meditation, Soundscapes, Focus, and
Library.

## Step 3: Breathing Tool (Resonance Breathing)
URL: https://monkeymind.app/resonance
Description: Guided breathing exercises including:
  - Box Breathing (4-4-4-4): Inhale 4s, Hold 4s, Exhale 4s, Hold 4s
  - 4-7-8 Relaxing Breath: Inhale 4s, Hold 7s, Exhale 8s
  - Coherent Resonance Breathing: 5.5s inhale / 5.5s exhale
All patterns use real-time visual pacing (an animated breath circle) and
zen audio chimes. Intended for relaxation only.

## Step 4: Zen Focus Timer
URL: https://monkeymind.app/timer
Description: A Pomodoro-technique productivity timer. Users set work/break
intervals and choose from ambient soundscapes: deep forest rain, babbling
brook, singing bowl drones, or zen chimes. Ideal for deep work and studying.

## Step 5: Guided Meditation
URL: https://monkeymind.app/meditate
Description: Voice-guided meditation sessions (2, 5 or 10 minutes) with a
breathing guide and the shared background sounds.

## Step 6: Sanctuary Library (Books & Audio)
URL: https://monkeymind.app/books
Description: A hand-picked list of books and audiobooks on mindfulness,
meditation and calm. Filter by books or audiobooks. Each entry has a short
note and a link to find it in a store.

## Step 7: Let It Go
URL: https://monkeymind.app/let-it-go
Description: Write down what is weighing on you and watch the words drift
away. Nothing is saved or sent anywhere.

## Step 8: Soundscapes
URL: https://monkeymind.app/soundscapes
Description: Blend calming ambient sounds (rain, ocean, wind, stream, warm
drone, singing bowls) with per-sound volume and a fade-out timer. The same
six sounds are available inside every tool and keep playing across pages.

# =========================================================
# KEY CONCEPTS & TERMINOLOGY
# =========================================================

- Monkey Mind: Buddhist term for the restless, uncontrolled, chattering mind
- Heartfulness: A heart-centered approach to mindfulness; cultivating warmth,
  compassion, empathy, and deeper awareness alongside traditional meditation
- Resonance Breathing: Slow breathing at ~6 breaths/minute, practised for
  relaxation
- Box Breathing: A steady 4-4-4-4 pattern many people use to unwind
- 4-7-8 Breathing: A popular wind-down relaxation breath
- Pomodoro Technique: 25-minute focused work sessions followed by 5-minute
  breaks; improves concentration and prevents burnout
- Default Mode Network (DMN): Brain's "resting state" network active during
  mind-wandering; meditation reduces DMN hyperactivity

# =========================================================

# =========================================================
# TECHNICAL DETAILS
# =========================================================

Platform: Web (React + Vite SPA)
Access: Free, no login required for core tools
Mobile: Fully responsive (mobile, tablet, desktop)
Audio: Web Audio API (no external audio files needed)
Backend: None. Static site with no accounts, tracking or database.
